title: Shortcut Mitigation via Spurious-Positive Samples
abstract: arXiv:2605.13340v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Shortcut mitigation strategies commonly rely on training data annotations, group-balanced held-out data or the presence of all groups, i.e., all combinations of (spurious) attributes and classes, in the training data. However, these requirements are rarely met in practice. We instead propose a method for targeted model analysis to identify a small set of instances in which the model relies on spurious attributes. Using that set and following ``this feature should not be used for prediction'' reasoning, we identify highly relevant neurons in an intermediate layer and regularize their impact. This ensures that models learn to depend on informative features rather than being right for the wrong reasons, thereby improving robustness without requiring additional balanced held-out data or annotations.

translated_title: 通过虚假正样本缓解捷径学习
translated_abstract: 捷径缓解策略通常依赖于训练数据标注、组平衡的保留数据，或者训练数据中存在所有组别，即（虚假）属性与类别的所有组合。然而，这些要求在实践中很少能够满足。我们转而提出一种有针对性的模型分析方法，用于识别模型依赖虚假属性的一小部分实例。利用该实例集，并遵循“此特征不应被用于预测”的推理逻辑，我们识别出中间层中高度相关的神经元，并对其影响进行正则化。这确保模型学会依赖有信息量的特征，而不是因为错误的原因而得出正确结果，从而在无需额外的平衡保留数据或标注的情况下提升模型的鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出一种无需数据标注或组平衡数据的新型捷径缓解方法，通过识别模型依赖虚假属性的少量实例，定位中间层中高度相关神经元并正则化其影响，使模型依靠真实有效特征进行预测，从而提升鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: A shortcut mitigation method that identifies a small set of instances where the model relies on spurious attributes, then localizes and regularizes highly relevant neurons in an intermediate layer—improving robustness without requiring annotations or group-balanced held-out data.
